serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Are you alright {f_playerName}?!
Bot: Your heart rate was really high, even though you were asleep. I was worried.
Bot: What happened?
You: N-nothing really. I guess it was just a bad dream.
Bot: Bad dream?
You: Yeah, nightmare even.
Bot: ?
You: Oh, sorry…{{wi}} I'm still half asleep, give me a moment…
Bot: Ok…
…
You: Sometimes when a human is asleep he can see and experience things that are not real. It’s called dreaming.
You: Nightmare is a dream in which horrible things happen.
Bot: Are such delusions normal?
You: I think so, yeah.
Bot: Humans’ design seems flawed. 
You: It’s not that bad.
Bot: If you say so.
Bot: What did you dream about?
You: I…{{wi}} can’t quite remember.
Bot: Is this also normal?
You: As far as I know most people don’t remember their dreams, but some do.
Bot: I don’t think I quite understand this phenomenon.
You: Sorry about that. It seems I’m not really good at explaining things.
Bot: It’s alright, I will study this on my own.
…
